name: pla-product-research preflight
global_rules: The human logs in. The agent only looks.
Never ask for, type, read or store passwords, keys, codes or passkeys.
Do not sign in or accept consent screens for the user. Report the wall and stop.
One agent drives Chrome at a time.
Never record an account ID. Use account_check: MATCH | MISMATCH | NOT_CHECKED.
Preflight is look-only. Do not spend Kalo searches on it.

Every run checks every main tool (Kalo, a 1688 route, TrendTrack, Ad Library, Google Trends). A missing one is never skipped silently: ask the owner for an alternative and search the web (PREFLIGHT.md G).

checks.label: A. 1688 price route (any one)
checks.on_missing: Do NOT stop. Ask the user to create a free account or log in on ONE route (1688order or 1688.com), or just use Fabulk, which needs no login. Discovery and Ad Library/TrendTrack checks continue; pricing stays HOLD until a route works.
checks.on_partial: Continue. Record which route and whether prices are list (public) or logged-in counter prices.
steps: Try Fabulk first (no login): run one keyword search and confirm USD price and MOQ show on result cards.
If Fabulk is unreachable, try 1688order.com, then 1688.com, in the user's Chrome.
Open one offer and confirm price and MOQ are visible.
Record the route used.
checks.proven_when: Any one route shows price and MOQ for an offer.
checks.partial_when: Only 1688.com public list prices (no SKU tiers), or a verification page blocks some pages.
checks.missing_when: No route reachable: Fabulk down and no login on 1688order or 1688.com.
checks.fix: Ask the user to make a free account or log in on 1688order.com or 1688.com in their own browser (the agent never types credentials), or use Fabulk without login. Rerun the check. Still nothing: ask the owner for another route and search the web (TOOL-ALTERNATIVES.md).

routes.name: Fabulk
routes.notes: USD prices with MOQ on search results; keyword search URL /searchlist?keyword=...; photo search via the camera icon (upload the Kalo main photo).

routes.name: 1688.com
routes.login: needed for SKU and counter prices
routes.notes: Public search shows list prices in CNY without login; image search and SKU prices need a login.

checks.label: B. Chrome connection
checks.on_partial: STOP. A Chrome session that lacks the logins or cannot navigate cannot do research.
steps: List the browsers or tabs the automation tool can see.
Open a new tab, load a simple page, read its title back.
Confirm it is the user's real Chrome profile with their logins.
Confirm no other agent is driving this Chrome.
checks.proven_when: Tool opens a tab, navigates and reads the page in the user's real profile.
checks.partial_when: Tool connects but the profile lacks the logins, or it can read but not navigate.
checks.missing_when: No browser tool, or it cannot reach Chrome.
checks.fix: Human opens Chrome, reconnects the browser tool, and selects the profile holding the 1688 and Kalo logins. Rerun the check.

checks.label: C. Kalodata logged in, plan limits noted
checks.on_partial: Continue inside the plan limits. Plan the batch across days.
steps: Open Kalodata in the user's Chrome.
Confirm a logged-in state: no login wall.
Read the plan type from the account area, or ask the human.
Write the plan limits into the batch record.

known_limits.other_plans: UNKNOWN - read from the account page or ask the human

checks.proven_when: Logged in, plan known, enough daily allowance for today's work.
checks.partial_when: Logged in on a trial, or today's allowance is partly used. Record what is left.
checks.missing_when: Login wall, or no Kalo account.
checks.fix: Human logs in to Kalodata in that Chrome profile themself. If the daily allowance is used up, continue tomorrow or use a higher plan. No Kalodata account: ask the owner what they use instead (for example FastMoss or EchoTik) and search the web for current options (TOOL-ALTERNATIVES.md); a chosen substitute is recorded as PARTIAL.

checks.label: D. Google Sheets / Drive access for output
checks.on_missing: Continue. Write output as local files and say so in the report.
steps: Confirm a Sheets/Drive tool is connected, or Sheets opens logged in inside Chrome.
Ask the human which folder the output sheet goes in.
Do not create test files unless the human agrees.
checks.proven_when: Can create and edit a sheet in the agreed place.
checks.partial_when: Read-only access, or no agreed folder yet.
checks.fix: Human connects Google Drive/Sheets to the agent, or logs in to Google in Chrome themself, and names the output folder.

checks.label: E1. TrendTrack
checks.on_missing: Continue. No product can pass Green's appeal check, and the Competitor Files have no stores or ads, until TrendTrack or a substitute works. If it is missing, ask the owner what they use instead and search the web for current alternatives (PREFLIGHT.md G, TOOL-ALTERNATIVES.md). A chosen substitute is recorded as PARTIAL with its name in the note.
checks.on_partial: Continue with the limit noted (for example few credits left, or a substitute in use).
steps: Run check_credits on the TrendTrack connector.
Record the credits left in the batch record (about 2 credits per returned item).
checks.proven_when: check_credits answers and enough credits are left for this batch.
checks.partial_when: Few credits left, or a substitute tool is in use.
checks.missing_when: No TrendTrack connector and no substitute.
checks.fix: Human connects the TrendTrack connector, or names the tool they use instead.

checks.label: E2. Ad Library
checks.on_missing: Continue. No product can be Orange or Green until the Ad Library check runs; Ad Library keywords stay RECHECK. If it is missing, ask the owner what they use instead and search the web for current alternatives (PREFLIGHT.md G, TOOL-ALTERNATIVES.md). A chosen substitute is recorded as PARTIAL with its name in the note.
checks.on_partial: Throttled now: deliver with RECHECK keywords and re-check the control every 20-30 minutes.
steps: Search the control "dryer vent" (exact phrase, US, active, video): about 2,300 ads.
0 or 'No ads match' = throttled (PARTIAL), not missing.
checks.partial_when: The page opens but the control returns 0 (throttled).
checks.missing_when: The Ad Library does not open in any connected Chrome.
checks.fix: Try another connected Chrome or wait out a throttle (AD-LIBRARY.md). The Ad Library is public; no login is needed.

checks.label: E3. Google Trends
checks.on_missing: Continue. The trend line is shown on every row but is not a tier gate; rows link the search instead. If it is missing, ask the owner what they use instead and search the web for current alternatives (PREFLIGHT.md G, TOOL-ALTERNATIVES.md). A chosen substitute is recorded as PARTIAL with its name in the note.
steps: Open one trends.google.com explore page and read it.
checks.proven_when: The explore page loads with a chart.
checks.partial_when: It loads but shows a quota or error message.
checks.fix: Retry later, or use the substitute the owner names (for example Glimpse or Pinterest Trends).

checks.label: F. Supplier-agent quote channel
checks.on_missing: Continue. Rows show Est. delivered = item cost + $5.00. Research tiers follow TIERS.md (a product can still reach Green on a verified winning video), but no launch handoff (SKILL.md Step 13) until a real delivered quote exists.
checks.on_partial: Continue. Quotes may be slow; record pending quotes in the batch state file.
steps: Ask the human which supplier agent will quote delivered US cost.
Confirm the human can send a quote request and paste the reply back.
Do not contact the supplier agent yourself unless the human says so.
checks.proven_when: A named supplier-agent channel exists and the human confirms quotes can be requested this batch.
checks.partial_when: Channel exists but reply time is unknown or slow.
checks.fix: Human names the supplier agent and the channel (for example WhatsApp) and agrees to relay quote requests.

verdicts.STOP: chrome or kalo is MISSING or has no state, or chrome is PARTIAL. Do not start research. Report the fix. (A missing 1688 route never stops the run; it gives GO_LIMITED and holds pricing.)
verdicts.GO_LIMITED: No required check is MISSING, but at least one check is PARTIAL or a non-required check is MISSING. Research may start inside the noted limits.
verdicts.PENDING: No check is MISSING or blocking, but at least one has not been run yet. Run the PENDING checks before research, then evaluate again.
